definitions.explanation: Describing physical pain or discomfort in a part of the body.
Can also describe emotional pain or embarrassment (slang: cringe).

examples.english: I have a headache. (My head hurts.)

examples.japanese: {足|あし}が{痛|いた}くて{歩|ある}けない。
examples.english: My leg hurts so much I can't walk.

examples.japanese: ここを{押|お}すと{痛|いた}いですか。
examples.english: Does it hurt when I press here?
examples.notes: Common question at a doctor's office

notes:
痛い conjugates as an i-adjective: 痛くない (negative), 痛くて (te-form), 痛かった (past). The pattern 「body part + が痛い」 is used to say a body part hurts.

Related:
- 痛み (いたみ - pain, noun)
- 痛める (いためる - to hurt/injure, verb).
